name: POST with content-digest covered, Ed25519
$comment: Signature is Ed25519 over expected_signature_base using the public test-only test-ed25519-2026 private key (_private_d_for_test_only) in keys.json. Ed25519 is deterministic, and tests/request-signing-vector-bodies.test.cjs re-signs and compares it. The Signature member is an RFC 8941 Byte Sequence (RFC 9421 §4.2), but the AdCP profile overrides RFC 8941's alphabet: see docs/building/by-layer/L1/security.mdx (section 'Binary value encoding'). Signature MUST be emitted as base64url WITHOUT padding, so it carries no '+', '/' or '='; the same test enforces that grammar. Content-Digest below is ALSO non-conformant under the same rule (security.mdx rule 1 names Signature and Content-Digest together), and is deliberately NOT fixed here: content-digest is a covered component, so its literal field value is part of expected_signature_base - re-encoding it would change the signed base and require a genuine re-sign, unlike the Signature token. Tracked as follow-up. Note also that a covered component's value in the signature base is the verbatim received field bytes; a verifier MUST NOT normalise Content-Digest to base64url before rebuilding the base, or this vector will fail to verify.
